tinker.name: Media Splitter
tinker.description: Split audio and video into multiple segments for export

zh-CN.name: 音视频分割
zh-CN.description: 将音视频切分成多段导出

open.description: Open an audio or video file for splitting. Same as opening a file in the UI. Returns media duration and metadata needed before setting segments.

path.description: Absolute path to an audio or video file

get.description: Get the currently open media, segment list, keyframe-cut setting, and output directory. Call open first.

set_segments.description: Replace all segments with the given time ranges (seconds). Call open first. Each segment must have end > start within the media duration.

segments.description: Segment ranges to keep; replaces the current list

export.description: Lossless-export all finished segments via FFmpeg stream copy. Call open and set_segments first. Returns output file paths. UI uses a configured output directory; MCP can override with outputDirectory.

outputDirectory.description: Absolute output directory. Empty string writes next to the source file. Defaults to the last used output directory (or source directory when empty).

keyframeCut.description: When true, seek with -ss before -i (fast, keyframe-aligned). Defaults to the current UI setting.
